Job Characteristics: Independently design, implement, and deploy intelligent systems powered by large language models (LLMs), agent orchestration frameworks, and embedding-based retrieval solutions. This role blends hands-on engineering with solution thinking focusing on scalable workflows, cloud-native delivery, and real-world GenAI application integration.
Education/Work Experience: Degree and 2-4 years experience.
Independence Level/Reports to: Normally reports to AI Engineering Manager.

Job Summary
As a Lead AI Engineer, you will own the design, delivery, and evolution of AI enabled legal solutions that support contract and compliance driven workflows across the enterprise. This role focuses on building and orchestrating agent based AI systems that integrate with Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms and enterprise workflow tools to ensure AI is embedded into governed, auditable legal processes.
You will lead endtoend solution design from intake through execution and post signature intelligence while making informed buy vs. build decisions, providing delivery estimation, and implementing scalable, secure AI solution architecture. This role requires close partnership with Legal, Procurement, Compliance, and IT, to deliver AI solutions that accelerate legal operations while maintaining regulatory and risk controls.
Key Responsibilities
Lead design and implementation of endtoend Legal AI workflows, including intake, orchestration, execution, and post signature intelligence
Evaluate and execute buy vs. build decisions for Legal AI capabilities, including delivery estimation, integration complexity, and total cost of ownership
Design and build custom AI agents to support legal use cases such as contract analysis, clause extraction, summarization, risk identification, and compliance validation
Implement orchestrated, multiagent systems that integrate AI services with CLM platforms and enterprise workflows
Architect and maintain secure, scalable integrations between AI systems and legal platforms, ensuring CLM remains the authoritative system of record
Establish engineering best practices for prompt design, agent orchestration, evaluation, monitoring, and AI governance in legal contexts
Collaborate closely with Legal, Procurement, Compliance, and IT stakeholders to translate legal requirements into durable AI solutions
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers contributing to Legal AI initiatives
Required Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field
610+ years of experience designing and delivering software or AI enabled systems in production environments
Strong experience building LLM powered applications, agentic workflows, and AI driven services
Proven ability to design endtoend enterprise workflows, including integrations with multiple business systems
Strong programming experience in Python and API based integration development
Experience leveraging AI assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code or similar) to accelerate agent development, integration, and iterative refinement
Demonstrated experience making architecture and delivery tradeoff decisions in complex enterprise environments
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical and nontechnical stakeholders
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) or legal workflow platforms
Familiarity with legal or enterprise platforms such as Agiloft, Eudia, ServiceNow App Engine, GEP CLM, or similar systems
Domain knowledge in any of the following areas:
Procurement contracting
Commercial and vendor contract lifecycle management
Marketing compliance
Legal or regulatory affairs
Experience implementing AI solutions that clearly separate intelligence layers, workflow orchestration, and systems of record

Youll work at the intersection of engineering and content designing prompt pipelines, integrating generative models, and building the tooling that turns source material into finished creative output. The ideal candidate is technically strong but also has taste: someone who understands story and craft, and can tell the difference between output thats technically correct and output thats actually good.

(1+/3+) years of engineering experience, or a strong portfolio of shipped projects

Experience deploying open-source models for inference (vLLM, ComfyUI, Replicate/Cog, Docker + GPU)

AMPITY INFOTECH

Job Description

AI Engineer

LLM / GenAI Systems | ML & Model Engineering | Applied AI Delivery

Location: Remote (India)

Employment Type: Full-time

Team: Client Delivery Engineering

Reports To: Tech Lead / Engagement Lead




About Ampity Infotech

Ampity Infotech is a cloud and DevOps engineering firm that helps growing companies design, build, and operate production-grade software and infrastructure on AWS. We work directly with client engineering and leadership teams, and we build AI-powered capabilities into client products as a core part of our delivery, not as a side experiment.




Role Summary

As an AI Engineer on Ampity's delivery team, you will design, build, and ship AI-powered capabilities for client products. The work spans applied LLM/GenAI engineering (RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, prompt design, evaluation) and classical ML/data science (model training, fine-tuning, feature engineering, deployment) depending on what an engagement calls for. You will be accountable for how these systems perform in production, meaning accuracy, latency, cost, and reliability, not just for a working prototype.




What You'll Own

Design and build LLM/GenAI-powered features: RAG pipelines, agentic or tool-calling workflows, prompt design, and integration with model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, etc.).
Build, fine-tune, and evaluate ML models where a classical or statistical approach fits the problem better than an LLM, including data preprocessing and feature engineering.
Design and run evaluation frameworks (offline evals, golden datasets, human-in-the-loop review) to measure accuracy, hallucination rate, and regressions before and after changes.
Deploy and operate AI/ML systems in production on AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, or EKS), with monitoring for drift, latency, and cost.
Own data pipelines that feed models and retrieval systems: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, and vector store management.
Apply security and responsible-AI practices: data handling, PII protection, prompt-injection defenses, and guardrails for AI-facing product surfaces.
Communicate model behavior, limitations, and trade-offs clearly to client engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders.
Produce implementation notes and handover documentation so client teams can operate and extend what you build.
Use AI-assisted coding tools as part of your own workflow, with the judgment to verify their output before it reaches production.



Required Qualifications

2-4 years of hands-on experience building and shipping AI/ML systems to production, not just research notebooks or proofs of concept.
Practical experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock) and at least one GenAI framework such as LangChain or LlamaIndex.
Solid Python skills, including experience with ML/data libraries (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow).
Experience building or operating RAG pipelines and working with vector databases or embedding stores (Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch, or similar).
Understanding of model evaluation methodology: metrics, test sets, and how to detect regressions or hallucinations.
Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS preferred) for deploying and serving models.
Ability to explain model behavior, limitations, and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.



Nice to Have

Experience fine-tuning open-source or foundation models (LoRA/PEFT, instruction tuning).
Experience with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, or custom tool-calling orchestration).
Familiarity with MLOps tooling (MLflow, SageMaker Pipelines, Weights & Biases).
Exposure to data engineering (Airflow, Spark, dbt) for building training or retrieval datasets.
Prior experience in a client-facing consulting or applied AI product environment.



What We Value

Ampity looks for AI engineers who ship systems that hold up in production, not just demos that work once. In practice, that means we weigh these traits heavily in this role:

AI fluency with scepticism you use AI and model outputs to move faster, and you know how to verify them before they reach production.
Production ownership — you understand incidents, cost, drift, and maintenance, not just initial delivery.
Trade-off reasoning — you compare a classical ML approach, an LLM, or a simpler rule-based system against the client's real constraints, rather than defaulting to the newest technique.
Clarity — you can explain a model's behavior and limitations, including its uncertainty, to a teammate and to a client.
Knowledge transfer — you make the team and the client stronger rather than accumulating private expertise.



How to Apply

Apply on – ta@ampityinfotech.com

We are looking for a curious and product-minded AI Engineer to join IKF s growing AI team. The ideal candidate should be able to transform real business problems into useful, reliable, and production-ready AI applications.

This role goes beyond prompt writing or adding chatbots to existing products. You will work across AI agents, conversational experiences, tool integrations, business workflows, backend systems, databases, and user interfaces.

If you enjoy experimenting with modern AI capabilities while also caring about product usability, engineering quality, and real-world business impact, this role offers the right opportunity.

Key Responsibilities
Design and build AI-powered products from concept to production.
Develop AI agents and multi-step workflows for real business use cases.
Design prompts, agent instructions, tool definitions, structured outputs, memory strategies, and multi-step AI workflows.

Build integrations using REST APIs, OAuth, MCP, webhooks, databases, and third-party services.

Strong proficiency in Python, TypeScript, or both, with experience building full-stack applications using frameworks such as FastAPI, Next.js, and React.
Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI agents, prompt design, tool calling, structured outputs, memory, and multi-step workflows.
Experience integrating REST APIs, OAuth, MCP, webhooks, databases, and third-party services.
Strong understanding of relational databases, authentication, backend architecture, and production application development.
Ability to evaluate, debug, deploy, and improve AI applications for accuracy, reliability, performance, and cost.
Strong product thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into working AI solutions.

Job Summary

About Tristone Strategic Partners LLP- Tristone Strategic Partners is a financial services firm based in Mumbai that provides investments and accounting-related support services and advisory services to international clients such as various investment funds, hedge funds, wealth management firms, start-ups corporates located across different geographies.

About the role- Tristone is embedding agentic AI directly into its workflows and systems. As a member of the Agentic AI engineering team, you'll help build agents, MCP servers, and evaluation loops that make AI generated code reliable, auditable, and fast to ship. You'll work closely with senior members of Tristone to deliver pragmatic, high-impact AI integrations at scale.

Key Responsibilities
Designing, building, and deploying AI-powered tools, agents, and workflow automations for use across the firm.
Working hands-on with the Claude ecosystem - Cowork, Claude Code, Connectors, Skills, and Plugins - alongside other AI platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, and others).
Owning the end-to-end deployment lifecycle for AI tools and agents, including packaging, testing, hosting, and monitoring in production.
Collaborating with teams across the firm to identify opportunities to automate repetitive or manual processes using AI and workflow orchestration tools.
Reviewing and validating AI-generated outputs to ensure accuracy, completeness, and reliability before they reach internal or client-facing use.
Staying current on evolving AI capabilities and evaluating new tools and platforms for potential adoption.
Documenting technical approaches clearly and communicating outcomes to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Exercising sound judgement across AI workflows: assessing which client and fund data may be sent to which model, working exclusively through approved endpoints and enterprise tooling, and upholding the confidentiality obligations expected in a financial services environment.
Complying with IT policies and procedures.
Maintaining the security of information at all times.
Requirements
AI Tools LLMs - Hands-on experience using platforms such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or Copilot, with the prompt-engineering skill to get consistent, high-quality outputs across models.
Agents and MCP - Hands-on experience building agentic workflows and integrating external tools through MCP servers or equivalent tool-use frameworks. Alongside this, a systematic approach to validating model output: maintained eval sets, regression checks before release, and structured human review loops, rather than ad-hoc spot checking.
Demonstrated Projects - Self-built AI projects or agents you can showcase, covering both standard and custom workflow-specific use cases. Projects built with Claude (Cowork, Claude Code, Connectors, Skills, Plugins) are particularly valued.
Prompt Engineering - Ability to structure prompts effectively - framing tasks clearly, refining outputs, and adapting instructions to get consistent, high-quality results across different AI models.
Build Deploy - Experience taking an AI tool or agent from build to production; packaging (Docker), hosting, and monitoring in a real environment.
Technical Skills - Python for scripting, API calls, and data pre-processing; SQL for querying structured data; React for simple internal dashboards; AI coding tools such as Claude Code or ChatGPT Codex.
Communication Collaboration - Good communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and explain technical work clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Qualifications
Bachelor or Master degree in computer engineering, Computer Science, or any other relevant specialization (e.g., AI/ML, Data Science, IT).
Experience
1+ years of relevant experience in AI/ML engineering, software development, or applied AI projects.
You should be able to clearly demonstrate how you have used AI tools - including Claude - to build, deploy, and improve efficiency, quality, or speed in a professional context.
Job Type
Full time
Location
Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
